---
title: Scampi Risotto
id: MAR-0098
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 65
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g rice
- 400 g scampi
- 2 g shallots
- 2 dl tomato passata
- 20 g butter
- 30 g sour butter
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Wash the scampi, shell them, and cook their shells in boiling water for 20 minutes.
2. Filter the water, salt it, and bring it to a boil.
3. Peel the shallots and let them wilt in a pan with half of the butter; after 5 minutes add the scampi and cook them for 3-4 minutes, lightly salting them.
4. In a saucepan, melt the remaining butter, and toast the rice for just over a minute.
5. Pour a ladle of scampi broth, stir, and gradually add more broth, keeping the rice constantly half-submerged, until it is cooked; once ready, turn off the heat, add the sour butter and the scampi, stir, and serve.
